title: Zeus Juice Adonis E-Liquid 50ml Shortfill
description: Adonis from Zeus Juice is a typically divine flavour experience from the UK mix masters, combining the taste of the freshest, sweetest strawberries and the rich, tart tang of ripe raspberries to create a truly unforgettable taste of the summer. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70% VG 30% PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , box mod vapes and sub-ohm tanks .
